Name: Aman Kumar
Roll No: 2401CS08

Assembler Features Implemented:

* Two pass assembler implemented
* Label detection and storage
* Duplicate label error detection
* Undefined label detection
* Invalid mnemonic detection
* Missing operand detection
* Generates object file (.o)
* Generates listing file (.lst)
* Generates log file (.log)
* Supports SET pseudo instruction
* Handles decimal, hexadecimal and octal operands

Emulator Features Implemented:

* Loads object file generated by assembler
* Implements registers A, B, PC, SP
* Executes SIMPLEX instruction set
* Provides instruction trace mode
* Provides memory dump before execution
* Provides memory dump after execution
* Detects infinite loops during execution

Test Cases:

* Multiple assembly programs tested
* Both successful execution and error cases included

Instructions to Run the Program (Windows):

1. Open Command Prompt and go to the project folder:
   cd C:\Users\Aman\Documents\Programs

2. Assemble the assembly program:
   asm.exe filename.asm

   This generates the following files:

   * filename.o   (object file)
   * filename.lst (listing file)
   * filename.log (log file)

3. Run the emulator in trace mode:
   emu.exe -t filename.o

   This displays instruction-by-instruction execution showing
   PC, SP, registers A and B, and the instruction executed.

4. Dump memory before execution:
   emu.exe -b filename.o

5. Dump memory after execution:
   emu.exe -a filename.o

6. Display the SIMPLEX ISA:
   emu.exe -I filename.o
